guide.title: How to read the graph
guide.color: Color is the idea's family: offer, market, channels…
guide.size: Size shows how often it has seen it and how much evidence it has.
guide.bet: The iridescent ring marks a bet your assistant is testing.
guide.verdict: A green ring is a bet that worked; coral, one that did not; amber is still open.
guide.lines: Lines are relations; they light up when you hover an idea.
guide.pulses: Pulses travel along what it learned in the last few days.
guide.timeline: Below, the timeline shows how it grew day by day.
